question: How much does the Team plan cost per user for a new customer signing up in August 2026?
reference_answer: $10 per user per month (the price changed from $8 on July 1, 2026).

question: I'm on a monthly plan. Can I get a refund if I cancel?
reference_answer: No. Monthly plans aren't refundable; you keep access until the end of the paid period.

question: Can we use SSO on the Team plan?
reference_answer: No. SSO is only available on the Business plan.

question: Which identity providers are officially supported for SSO?
reference_answer: Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), and Google Workspace.

question: Can I get my two-factor codes by text message?
reference_answer: No. SMS 2FA was removed in August 2025; use an authenticator app (TOTP).

question: How long do I have to download a data export?
reference_answer: 7 days. Export download links expire after 7 days.

question: What is the API rate limit on the Business plan?
reference_answer: 600 requests per minute per API token.

question: How often does Tidepool sync with Google Calendar?
reference_answer: Every 5 minutes.

question: We accidentally deleted our workspace two weeks ago. Can it be recovered?
reference_answer: Yes. Deleted workspaces are recoverable for 30 days; the owner can contact support to restore it.

question: Where is EU customer data stored?
reference_answer: In Frankfurt, Germany (EU data residency, Business plan).

question: I own our workspace. How do I delete my account?
reference_answer: First transfer ownership to another admin or delete the workspace; then delete your account.

question: Auto-approve is on for our schedule. Does a swap for a shift starting tomorrow still need a manager?
reference_answer: Yes. Swaps for shifts starting within 48 hours always need manager approval, even with auto-approve on.

question: Our Business workspace had 99.7% uptime last month. What service credit do we get?
reference_answer: 20% of that month's fee (10% for each full 0.1% below 99.9%).

question: How is data encrypted at rest?
reference_answer: With AES-256.

question: Can I clock in from the mobile app without an internet connection?
reference_answer: No. Offline mode is view-only; you can't clock in until you're back online.

question: We're on Business. What's our API rate limit, and can our identity provider deactivate users automatically?
reference_answer: 600 requests per minute per token, and yes: SCIM provisioning (Business) can deactivate users automatically.

question: How many hours of unused time off carry over into the next year?
reference_answer: Up to 40 hours, unless an admin raises the cap.

question: Does Tidepool integrate with Microsoft Teams?
reference_answer: Not answerable from the documentation. Only Slack and Google Calendar integrations are documented.

question: How much does the Enterprise plan cost?
reference_answer: Not answerable from the documentation. There is no Enterprise plan in the docs.

question: Who is Tidepool's CEO?
reference_answer: Not answerable from the documentation.
